description: This is a Python script for performing an end-to-end 'smoke test' of a backend API service, including health checks, tenant and meter creation, readings ingestion, analytics execution, and UI listing calls, with artifact logging for debugging.

methods.name: int main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None)
